transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Glad to hear that. Is your eye currently red?

transcript.text: No, there is no redness in my eye. It's feeling fine overall.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Is your eye currently painful?

transcript.text: No, there's no pain in my eye. My recovery has been smooth.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That’s good. Has your vision improved as you expected since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, my vision has improved and my recovery has been smooth.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great. Have you noticed any floaters since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I haven't noticed any floaters. My eye is feeling fine overall.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you noticed any flashing lights since the surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, I haven't noticed any flashing lights. Everything has been fine with my recovery.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Thanks — here’s a quick summary of what you’ve told me so far:

- Overall recovery: eye is doing fine and recovery has been smooth
- Redness: no redness
- Pain: no pain
- Vision: vision has improved as expected
- Floaters: none noticed
- Flashing lights: none noticed

verdict.label: pass
